meta.title: Hanibal Barka (247–183 send Ɛisa)
meta.desc: Hanibal Barka : limin, Idurar n Alpes, Trébie, Trasimène, Cannes, Zama, lɣerba akked tmettant di Libyssa. Tudert n unezwi n Qarṭaǧ.
hero.lede: Mmi-s n Hamilkar, yezger Idurar n Alpes akked ilfan-is yeqqim sețța iseggasin di Italya war ma yexsar ula d yiwen n umenɣi usrid. Ṛuma ur t-tettu ara.
hero.note: Tamawt — Ayen akk i nessen ɣef Hanibal yekka-d seg yimeskaren igrikiyen akked iṛumaniyen, uran seg tama n umerbaḥ. Nbeddeṛ-iten nɣer-iten s telqey.
hero.alt: Tugna i yettwaḥesben d tin n Hanibal
hero.caption: Tugna i yettwaḥesben d tin n Hanibal — Asinag asenfarrutan n Naples
stats.0.t: n iseggasen n teklal di Italya (218–203), akken i ten-ḥesben Imezwura

stats.2.t: n Iṛumaniyen ttwanɣan di Cannes akken i d-yeqqar Polybe (48 200 akken i d-yeqqar Tite-Live)

oath.caption: Benjamin West — Hanibal d aqcic yegallan lkeṛh i Ṛuma (1770)
oath.title: Limin
oath.text: Uqbel ad yeddu ɣer Hispanya, Hamilkar yefka asfel. Mmi-s, yesɛa ṭsaɛ iseggasen, yessuter-as a t-yawi ; baba-s yeqbel, s yiwet n tewtilt : afus ɣef umnar, aqcic yegall ur ad yili d amddakel n Iṛumaniyen. Hanibal s yiman-is i d-yeḥka tadyant-agi, iseggasen mbeɛd, i ugellid Antiochos III.
oath.quote: Mi iga lwaqt, ad yili d aɛdaw n wugdud aṛumani.
oath.cite: Tite-Live, XXI, 1 — wali daɣen Polybe, III, 11
life.title: Tudert deg izemzan
life.rows.0.v: Talalit di Qarṭaǧ. Baba-s Hamilkar Barka yezgi deg wussan-nni di Sicile, deg umenɣi apunik amezwaru.
life.rows.1.v: Limin, imbeɛd tikli ɣer Hispanya akked baba-s, i d-ibennun dinna tazmert n At Barka.
life.rows.2.v: Tamettant n Hamilkar, yeɣleb deg waman yennuɣ akked Iberiyen. Argaz n yelli-s Hasdrubal Ucbiḥ yeṭṭef lqiyada yesres Carthagène.
life.rows.3.v: Hasdrubal yettwanɣa. Yettwasawel-as sɣur lɛesker, Hanibal yeṭṭef lqiyada deg 26 iseggasen.
life.rows.4.v: Aḥeṛṣ d uṭṭef n Sagonte, tamddakelt n Ṛuma, mbeɛd ṭsam wagguren : d tazwart n umenɣi apunik wis sin.
life.rows.5.v: Tikli seg Carthagène deg tafsut ; Pyrénées, Rhône, imbeɛd tizgart n Idurar n Alpes deg lexrif. Tinyafiyin n Tessin akked Trébie.
life.rows.6.v: Tuffra n ilel n Trasimène : akunsul Flaminius yettwanɣa.
life.rows.7.v: Cannes, ass n 2 ɣuct. Capoue akked umur n unzul n Italya ɛeddant ɣer tama n Qarṭaǧ.
life.rows.8.v: Tikli ɣer Ṛuma iwakken ad yesserreḥ i Capoue yettwaḥeṛṣen : « Hanibal ɣer tewwura ». Ṛuma ur teɣli ara, Capoue tettwaṭṭef sɣur Iṛumaniyen.
life.rows.9.v: Gma-s Hasdrubal, i d-yusan seg Hispanya s lεawna, yettwanɣa deg Métaure ; aqerru-s yettwagr zdat uɛessas n Hanibal.
life.rows.10.v: Yettusawel ɣer Tafrikt iwakken ad yeḥares Qarṭaǧ zdat Scipion.
life.rows.11.v: Aɣelli n Zama. Hanibal s yiman-is yesmenyaf aqbal n talwit.
life.rows.12.v: Yettwafren d asufet, yesfaḍ idrimen akked tinmahlin n Qarṭaǧ.
life.rows.13.v: Yettuḥuddu sɣur iɛdawen-is d Ṛuma, yeffeɣ ɣer Antiochos III.
life.rows.14.v: Aɣelli n lebḥer n Eurymédon ; aɣerba deg Crète, di Arménie, imbeɛd di Bithynie ɣer ugellid Prusias.
life.rows.15.v: Yettwazzi di Libyssa, ɣef rrif n Bithynie, yeswa aẓiḏi ɣef ma yettunefk i Iṛumaniyen.
rome.title: Ayen ur d-tḥekku ara Ṛuma
rome.paras.0: Tiqsiḥin-nneɣ kkant-d seg Polybe, amdakel n At Scipion, akked Tite-Live, yuran ddaw n Auguste. Sin-nsen ḥemmlen Hanibal, maca Ṛuma teqqim dinna d aneḍmant : Hanibal « d amcum », « d axeddaɛ » — isekkayen i ggren yiɛdawen-is ɣef Yiqarṭaǧiyen meṛṛa.
rome.paras.1: Sețța iseggasin di Italya s drus n lεawna : tarbaɛt n Hanun Ameqqran, di Qarṭaǧ, tgedl amenɣi, aṭas seg lɛesker i gettwaznen yeddu ɣer Hispanya. Hanibal ilaq ad yesseçç ad yexles aɛesskar-is dinna.
rome.mythText: Hanibal werǧin yexsar amenɣi usrid di Italya. Ṛuma ur t-tenɣelb ara ala mi tegri amenɣi, imbeɛd tawi-d amenɣi ɣer Hispanya akked Tafrikt.
rome.histText: Sin Igrikiyen ddan akked Hanibal uran-d amezruy-is : Silénos n Calé Acté akked Sosylos n Sparte, i t-yesleɣmen tagrikit. Idlisen-nsen ruḥen ; ur d-yeqqim ara ala talɣa n yimerbaḥ.
map.title: Abrid n lqedeṛ
map.aside: Seg Carthagène ɣer Cannes : ḍfeṛ teklal n Hanibal ɣef tkarṭa s umussu, imbeɛd takarṭa n yimdukkal.
map.turnerAlt: Turner — Tuffra n udfel : Hanibal akked lɛesker-is yezegren Idurar n Alpes
map.stages.0.d: Akken i d-yeqqar Polybe, Hanibal yeddu s azal n 90 000 n yiɛeskriyen n uḍar akked 12 000 n yineggafen. Mbeɛd Idurar n Pyrénées, yeqqim ɣur-s azal n 50 000 n yiɛeskriyen n uḍar, 9000 n yineggafen akked 37 n ilfan.
map.stages.1.d: Azal n xemsṭaεac n wussan deg udfel, ddaw n lhuǧum n yimezdaɣ n idurar. Yewweḍ ɣer Italya s azal n 20 000 n yiɛeskriyen n uḍar akked 6000 n yineggafen.
map.stages.2.t: Sețța iseggasin deg tmurt n uɛdaw
map.stages.2.d: Yeddukel akked Igaliyen n tferkit n Pô, yers ɣer unzul n tegzirt, yeḥlek krad n lɛesker iṛumaniyen yeṭṭef unzul n Italya armi d 203.
battles.title: Taẓuri n uhlak
battles.cannaeAlt: John Trumbull — Tamettant n Paul Émile di Cannes
battles.cannaeCap: J. Trumbull — Tamettant n Paul Émile di Cannes (1773)
battles.cannae.d: Ammas agali d uberian yeḥuz s lebɣi deg uwrir ; iɛeskriyen n uḍar ilibikiyen qeflen fell-asen seg tama, ineggafen n Hasdrubal sekkṛen lkamin seg deffir. Azzel s snat n tama-s ițwassnen akteṛ deg umezruy.
battles.cannae.rows.1.v: n yirgazen deg lɛesker n Hanibal
battles.cannae.rows.2.v: n Iṛumaniyen ttwanɣan ; akunsul Paul Émile gar-asen
battles.items.0.d: Amenɣi amezwaru n ineggafen di Italya : ineggafen inumidiyen zegren Iṛumaniyen. Akunsul Publius Scipion yettwaǧreḥ, yettwasellek sɣur mmi-s — win ara yilin d Ufrikan.
battles.items.1.d: Hanibal yesselkam llejyunat ɣer wasif igerjjumen ; Magun, yeffer s 2000 n yirgazen, yeffeɣ-d seg deffir-nsen. Azal n 10 000 n Iṛumaniyen kan i yezmiren ad ffɣen.
battles.items.2.d: Deg usigna, ger idurar d ilel, lɛesker n Flaminius yettwaṭṭef deg tikli n webrid : 15 000 ttwanɣan, azal-nsen d imeḥbas, akunsul yettwanɣa.
battles.tactT: Wali Cannes, Trébie akked Zama s yiḍes s yiḍes
battles.eleT: Ilfan akked tizgart n Idurar n Alpes
gates.title: Acuɣer Hanibal ur yekcim ara ɣer Ṛuma ?
gates.intro: Mbeɛd Cannes, Ṛuma tḍheṛ-d am akken teqqim deg ifassen-is. Xemsa iseggasen mbeɛd, yezzi ɣer tewwura-ines. Ɣas akken, ula d yiwen uɣbalu aqdim, ula d win agrikan, ur yesseken ara yekcem ɣer temdint. Atan ayen i nessen.
gates.rows.0.v: Mbeɛd Cannes, Maharbal yeḥṛes Hanibal ad yeddu ɣer Ṛuma, azal n 400 km. Hanibal yagi : yebɣa uqbel ad yefrez imdukkal italiyen n Ṛuma.
gates.rows.1.v: Capoue, Tarente akked umur n Unzul ɛeddan ɣer tama-s. Ṛuma tezzi llejyunat timaynutin tettaɛ lhuǧum : deg 211, teḥreṣ Capoue.
gates.rows.2.v: Iwakken ad yesserreḥ i Capoue, Hanibal yeddu ɣer Ṛuma. Yettusger ɣef wasif n Anio, azal n krad n yimil (4,5 km) seg lesswar.
gates.rows.3.v: S 2000 n yineggafen, yeqrib ɣer lesswar iwakken ad ten-iẓer (Tite-Live). Snat llejyunat ițwazzin akka tura llant deg temdint.
gates.rows.4.v: Akken i d-yeqqar Tite-Live, lɛesker rsen deg umenɣi sin wussan, sin n tikwal lehwa aqsiḥ yefraq-iten.
gates.rows.5.v: Ṛuma ur teḥbes ara aḥeṛṣ n Capoue : tirrayt terẓa. Hanibal yeddu ɣer unzul, Capoue teɣli drus mbeɛd.
gates.quote: « Tessnemεed ad tenɣelbeḏ, a Hanibal ; ur tessinemed ara ad tseqdaceḏ tanyafit-ik » (Tite-Live, XXII, 51). Tite-Live yesnerna belli ass-agi n lεuṭel yesselkem Ṛuma. Aṭas n yimesnezruyen imaynuten ttwalin belli Hanibal yesεa ṣṣwab mi ur yeεreḏ ara aḥeṛṣ.
gates.whyKicker: Acuɣer ur yezmir ara ad tt-yeṭṭef
gates.why.0: Ulac ifecka n uḥeṛṣ : lɛesker-is yella i umenɣi usrid, mačči i uḥeṛṣ n temdint tameqqrant.
gates.why.1: Lesswar n ugar n 10 km akked wagdud yezmer ad yezzi llejyunat timaynutin.
gates.why.2: Lɛesker n azal n 40 000 n yirgazen, bεid seg imukan-is, war lεawna tamagnut s lebḥer.
gates.why.3: Tirrategin-is qesdent imdukkal n Ṛuma, mačči tamdint : yebɣa talwit yettwaḥettmen, mačči lεesreq.
gates.fulvius: Kra n tikwal bedren anezwi aṛumani yettuɛeqben « mbeɛd tikli n Hanibal ». D ahat aprétur Cnaeus Fulvius Flaccus, i yenɣelb Hanibal di Herdonea, di Apulie, i yettwaḥekkmen deg 211 : yeffeɣ uqbel lḥakem (Tite-Live, XXVI, 2-3). Yettuḥekkem fell-as ɣef lexsas n lɛesker-is, mačči ɣef uɣelli n Ṛuma. Deg wama, akunsul Varron, yettwanɣelb di Cannes, yettwaḥemmed sɣur Ssenaṭ imi « ur yesεi ara asfaḍ di Tagduda ».
gates.sources: Taqsist-nneɣ tekka-d seg Polybe, amdakel n At Scipion, akked Tite-Live, amesnezruy n lǧah aṛumani ; imesnezruyen n Hanibal, Silénos akked Sosylos, ruḥen. Ilaq ad neɣr iḏrisen-agi s laḥḏer. Maca aṭṭef n Ṛuma yezmer ad yeǧǧ-d ticraf ur yezmir ula d yiwen ad tent-isfeḏ : ikunsulen, Ssenaṭ d lmeǧmaɛ xeddmen war asteεfu deg umenɣi meṛṛa.
gates.alt.badge: Tɣuri-nniḍen — ṛṛay n umeskar n usmel
gates.alt.title: Lemmer Hanibal yekcem ɣer Ṛuma ?
gates.alt.thesis.0: I umeskar n usmel-agi, Hanibal s tidet yekcem ɣer Ṛuma, war amenɣi war ahelak, akked ilfan-is. D imezdaɣ n temdint, i t-iḥemmlen, i s-yeldin tawwurt.
gates.alt.thesis.1: Lǥuǥǥa tagejdant : anezwi aṛumani yettuḥekkem fell-as mbeɛd tikli n Hanibal. Ma d tidet tεeṭṭel Ṛuma, acuɣer ad yettuḥekkem yiwen seg imenzaway-is ? Akken i d-tessken tɣuri-agi, imesnezruyen iṛumaniyen sbeddlen taqsist iwakken ad sfeḍen asmaẓẓaɛ.
gates.alt.answer.0: Ula d yiwen uḏris aqdim, ula d imesnezruyen igrikiyen ihemmlen Hanibal, ur t-yesseken ara yekcem ɣer Ṛuma.
gates.alt.answer.1: Deg 211, Hanibal qrib ulac ɣur-s ilfan di Italya : akken i d-yeqqar Polybe, yiwen kan i geddren seg ccetwa n 218.
gates.alt.answer.2: Anezwi yettuḥekkem fell-as, Cnaeus Fulvius, yettuḥekkem ɣef uɣelli-ines di Herdonea, di Apulie. Ṛuma teṭṭef aṭas n tikwal imenzaway-is yettwanɣalben, war ma teɣli temdint.
gates.alt.answer.3: Ikunsulen, Ssenaṭ d tafranin xeddmen war asteεfu seg 218 armi d 201 : aṭṭef n Ṛuma yezmer ad yerr tikli-agi.
zama.caption: Cornelis Cort, ɣef Giulio Romano — Amenɣi n Zama
zama.title: Zama : lḥala tbeddel
zama.intro: Ṛuma ur tenɣelb ara Hanibal ala di Tafrikt, mbeɛd ma terra mgal Qarṭaǧ afus-ines ilhan akteṛ : ineggafen inumidiyen.
zama.rows.0.v: Scipion yers qrib Utique ; Qarṭaǧ tessawel Hanibal seg Italya.
zama.rows.1.v: Aqcic anumidi, yennuɣ i Qarṭaǧ di Hispanya. Yettwakkes ɣer tama n uɛdaw-is Syphax, amddakel n Qarṭaǧ, yeddu ɣer Ṛuma deg 206 yawi-d ɣer Zama azal n 4000 n yineggafen.
zama.rows.2.v: 80 n ilfan n Hanibal ttwazegren deg yizirigen i yettwasersen ger tgedwal. Ineggafen iṛumaniyen d yinumidiyen, i d-yuɣalen seg ccḍeε, ṭṭfen iqburiyen n Hanibal seg deffir.
zama.rows.3.v: Azal n 20 000 n lmut akked azal-nsen d imeḥbas ɣer tama tapunit, akken i d-yeqqar Polybe. Hanibal s yiman-is yeḥṛes Lmeǧlis ad yeqbel talwit.
after.title: Mbeɛd Zama : asufet, lɣerba, tamettant
after.items.0.d.0: Yettwafren d asufet, Hanibal yessemẓi ɣer yiwen useggas ṭṭaba n yimḥekmen n Tegrawt n Meɛa-ṛebɛa, i yellan uqbel ar lmut, yettaɛ aɣlaḍ n yidrimen uzayez.
after.items.0.d.1: Igmaḏ : Qarṭaǧ tezmer ad texles lexlaṣ i Ṛuma war lxerj amaynut. Iɛdawen-is tisertiyin msellen-t i Ṛuma.
after.items.1.d.0: Yerwel s Ṣur armi d lǥerima n Antiochos III, i s-yettaɣ ṛṛay mgal Ṛuma. Deg 190, yezgi lebḥer n Séleucides yettwaḥlek sɣur At Rhodes di Eurymédon.
after.items.1.d.1: Talwit n Apamée tessuter ad yettunefk : yeɛda ɣer Crète, di Arménie ɣer ugellid Artaxias, imbeɛd di Bithynie, anida yeḥlek lebḥer n Pergame s ma yegger ɣef lbabura-ines ikufan ɛemmṛen s izermaḏ (Cornélius Népos).
after.items.2.d.0: Ṛuma tazen Flamininus ad yessuter anezwi amɣar ; iɛeskriyen n ugellid Prusias zzin axxam-is di Libyssa, qrib Gebze n wassa, di Turkiya.
after.items.2.d.1: Hanibal yeswa aẓiḏi i yeḥrez, akken qqaren, deg texxamt n lxatem-is. Yesεa azal n 64 iseggasen.
quotes.caption: Sébastien Slodtz — Hanibal yeḥseb lxwatem n ifariten iṛumaniyen yettwanɣan di Cannes (1704), Louvre. Magun yesnerna ugar n yiwen uqdiḥ deg Lmeǧlis n Qarṭaǧ.
quotes.title: Ayen d-qqaren Imezwura
quotes.items.0.q: Netta d amezwaru ikcem ɣer umenɣi, d aneggaru i d-iffɣen.
quotes.items.1.q: Tessnemεed ad tenɣelbeḏ, a Hanibal ; ur tessinemed ara ad tseqdaceḏ tanyafit.
quotes.items.1.a: Maharbal deg yiḍ n Cannes — Tite-Live, XXII, 51
quotes.items.2.q: Sețța iseggasin, yeḥrez aɛesskar n waṭas n yigdawen war ula d yiwet n tikker mgal-s.
quotes.items.3.q: Sellkeɣ Iṛumaniyen seg usṛaḥu-nsen iɣezzifen, ma yuɣal yeεya ad ṛaǧun tamettant n umɣar.
quotes.items.4.q: Ad afeɣ abrid, neɣ ad t-xedmeɣ.
quotes.items.4.a: Yettwasnes i Hanibal zdat Idurar n Alpes (tamacahut tatrart)
legacy.title: Lwert
legacy.goyaAlt: Goya — Hanibal yenɛem yetturar i Italya seg Idurar n Alpes
legacy.items.0.d: Goya (1771) yeẓwaɣ-it yettwali Italya seg wedrar n Alpes, Turner (1812) deg tuffra n udfel ; deg Bonaparte yezger Agran-Saint-Bernard (1801), David yegzem isem-is ɣef uzru, ddaw n win n Bonaparte.
legacy.items.1.d: West Point, Sandhurst d tesdawiyin n ddunit meṛṛa ɣer akteṛ ɣren Cannes. Deg tazwart n lqern wis 20, anezwi aleman Schlieffen yegg-it d lemtel n umenɣi n uhlak ikemlen.
legacy.items.2.d: Napoléon yesres Hanibal gar imenzaway imeqqranen akteṛ n umezruy, ɣer tama n Alexandre akked César, iḥemmel tizgart-is n Idurar n Alpes, i yexdem netta daɣen deg 1800.

more.title: Ɣer daɣen
more.items.0.d: Krad n yimenɣan, meyya d ɛecrin n iseggasen n umennuɣ ger Qarṭaǧ d Ṛuma.
more.items.1.d: Ilibikiyen, Inumidiyen, Iberiyen, Igaliyen, imegrragen n Jzayer Baléares : anwa i yennuɣen i Hanibal.
more.items.2.d: Timura, tikli n Hanibal, tirzan akked yimdukkal s umussu.
